verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions bulk catalog import or export, CSV handling, or batch product-edit endpoints. The only related item is the existence of Admin REST API OpenAPI specs (medusa-gh-x1). A general admin API is a developer building block, not documented bulk catalog operations. The Product Module citation (medusa-docs-21) is only a page title with no content about bulk operations.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can bulk import, export, and edit the catalog — CSV or API — without touching products one at a time
